reason: A settings-page plugin manager that organizes DSH plugins, supports user-plugin lifecycle operations, persists descriptions, and provides failure diagnostics.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DSH 设置页分类查看插件，并管理用户扩展的启用、停用、卸载、描述和故障诊断。
summaries.en: A DSH settings-page plugin manager for categorizing plugins and managing user extensions, including activation, deactivation, removal, descriptions, and failure diagnostics.

capabilities: Displays installed native, user, and runtime plugins in categorized views
Enables or disables user plugins and persists activation changes
Uninstalls user plugins and updates profile configuration
Diagnoses inactive or failed user plugins and generates repair prompts
